the-phlip-side.title: What is The PHlip-side?
the-phlip-side.body: **The PHlip-side** brings together published columns and editorials originally written for Pulmonary Hypertension News (Bionews). These pieces explore life with pulmonary hypertension, chronic illness, advocacy, healthcare experiences, identity, grief, resilience, and the complicated reality of learning to live in a body that does not always cooperate.

scleroderma-foundation-of-greater-chicag.title: What is Beyond the Column?
scleroderma-foundation-of-greater-chicag.body: Beyond the Column brings together select published articles, features, and contributed pieces written beyond the regular column space for healthcare, nonprofit, and advocacy communities.

rants-of-the-psyche.title: What You'll Find Inside:
rants-of-the-psyche.body: Rants in Writing is a collection of personal reflections that explore identity, resilience, mental health, grief, growth, advocacy, and the emotional realities that often accompany chronic and rare disease.

tips-tricks.title: What You'll Find Inside:
tips-tricks.body: Tips & Tricks is a collection of practical lessons, lived-experience insights, and everyday strategies gathered through years of navigating healthcare, advocacy, and life with chronic illness.
